name: kit
description: Bootstrap projects with selected blocks and Git hosting; search, install, adapt, verify, harvest and publish reusable features.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap projects and install tested feature blocks
interface.longDescription: Create Worker, vinext or local Rust server projects with compatible blocks and optional Git hosting. The local MCP server also searches, installs and verifies blocks, with a dry-run diff for existing projects. Pstack can supply the engineering playbook as a separate optional dependency.
defaultPrompt: Use $kitbash-bootstrap to create a vinext project with cache blocks.
Use $kitbash-use to add email sign-in to this project.
Use $kitbash-use to find a block for rate limiting and install it.
Use $kitbash-harvest to turn this feature into a block.
Use $kitbash-publish to publish this block privately.
